privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.text: Plume runs entirely on your computer. No data is collected or sent. It only reads your home folder (ignoring dependency folders such as node_modules or vendor) and never permanently deletes your files: they go to the trash. System changes go through your distribution's permission prompt. Your settings are stored locally.
